answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can require every identity to post a refundable stake into a shared lagoon pool before trading, with the stake slashed on proven fraud. A prism of independent attestors - peers, oracles and reputation services - verifies each agent's work, so a fake identity must buy many stakes and pass many checks. A gale of cheap fake accounts then costs more than it earns: creating 1,000 sockpuppets at 10 POA each burns 10,000 POA, while one honest identity costs 10.
